ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (28) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Attributions are given in their English forms, surname only as printed: «Марцеллин» (Martsellin) is Marcellinus and «Буаст» (Buast) is Boiste (the site draft had added 'Pierre'). The root of «сближать» (sblizhat', 'draw together') is kept in both sentences of passage 9.
Source observation: [17] «Хорошие речи просты, понятны всем и разумны» ends without a final period; probably a transcription slip. English mirrors it.
